Evidence & scope

Distinct primary paper work or creator-named benchmark family. Actual complete primary-text and declared selected-visual/creator-document scopes have exact author, separate source-verifier and adversarial AI reviews on the approved bounded assertions. Original first-submitted drafts and their genuine revise history are preserved. Raw dataset payloads were not recounted, experiments were not rerun, upstream rights were not independently cleared and no supplier role is inferred. This admission is not a frozen-core denominator decision.

Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

CharXiv · documents: The primary paper and creator releases distinguish CC BY-SA 4.0 questions and answers from Apache 2.0 code, while chart copyright remains with the original arXiv authors; the creator dataset card states that the dataset is for evaluation and must not be used for model training.

Permanent record ID: candidate.normal18.charxiv.family.component-rights-and-use

  • Original author-stage note: Actual new author-only source-content proposal. Distinct source-verifier/adversarial exact-digest reviews and coordinator identity/disposition are pending. No replication, independent rights adjudication, commercial supplier credit, or deep credit.
  • These are source-declared component terms and usage restrictions, not a blanket license to the original charts or an independent legal determination. A repository-wide code license must not be applied to all dataset components.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

CharXiv · documents: The v1 paper reports 2,323 charts, with four descriptive questions and one reasoning question per chart: 9,292 descriptive and 2,323 reasoning questions; it splits charts into 1,000 validation and 1,323 test examples.

Permanent record ID: candidate.normal18.charxiv.family.question-units-and-splits.binding-correction-v1

  • Original author-stage note: Actual new author-only source-content proposal. Distinct source-verifier/adversarial exact-digest reviews and coordinator identity/disposition are pending. No replication, independent rights adjudication, commercial supplier credit, or deep credit.
  • The four descriptive questions include one intentionally unanswerable item. These are chart and question counts, not counts of annotators; no payload recount was performed. Creator README line40 instead says 2,333 images while its introduction says 2,323, so that release-description discrepancy is retained.
